title: InspectorRequirement
description: A named, provider-neutral evidence requirement. The kernel says 'this envelope needs iac-format and artifact-secret-scan'; a target profile decides that iac-format means terraform fmt today and something else tomorrow. The generic name is the contract; the binding is data. This is what stops the core from learning the name of a scanner.

requirement_id.description: Generic inspector name, e.g. artifact-integrity, iac-format, iac-lint. Never a tool name.

blocking.description: Whether a downstream handoff may be produced without this requirement satisfied. Non-blocking requirements still record evidence - they simply do not stop the composition.

applies_to.description: Artifact paths this requirement covers. Empty means every artifact in the manifest.
